body: Cost Management is a set of tools for checking and controlling what you spend on Azure. Cost analysis shows your costs visually, and you can view totals by billing cycle, region, resource, subscription or resource group. Cost alerts collect the warnings in one place, such as budget alerts and credit alerts. A budget is a spending limit you set for a subscription, resource group or service type. When spending reaches the alert level, an alert appears and an email can be sent. Budgets can also trigger automation, for example shutting down nonproduction resources when a threshold is reached.
